title: 2026 Frost & Sullivan Technology Innovation Leadership Recognition Report
summary: Ameresco Receives Frost & Sullivan’s 2026 North America Technology Innovation Leadership Recognition for Advancing Resilient Microgrid Infrastructure
body_markdown:
> “Building on this technological foundation, Ameresco develops and deploys advanced microgrid systems that function as intelligent energy platforms. Through integrated control architectures, real-time monitoring, and lifecycle optimization, these systems dynamically manage energy flows, enhance system reliability, and reduce dependence on centralized infrastructure.”
>
>
> Chippy Alphons Augustine, Research Analyst for Frost & Sullivan.
